subject: Converting an advector object to a numeric object

messages.author: 870af6cbd03ec87e
messages.subject: Converting an advector object to a numeric object
parts:
Hi all, 

Is there a way to convert an advector object to a numeric object? In the latest version of RTMB, if I run something like: 

obj <- advector(2) # Creating an advector object with value '2'
as.numeric(obj)

The last line doesn't produce a numeric vector (it remains an advector object). Is there some other way to take an advector object and convert it to a numeric vector? 

Thank you!
Rishika

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Converting an advector object to a numeric object
parts:
Converting advector to double is made difficult on purpose, because it implicitly drops derivative tracking.
There is no exported function to do it, but one can use RTMB:::getValues.
 
Note that Ben's 'fixtmb' hack is not guarantied to work, as it relies on the internal AD storage in the special case where the advector is constant.

On Tuesday, October 29, 2024 at 1:22:38 AM UTC+1 Ben Bolker wrote:
I've used this:

fixtmb <- function(x) Im(unclass(x))
